F-SR3 (MEDIUM): Online retrieval hijack of a reasoning prompt — R01's 'Amina' matched an HMS Patients doc through the relaxed gate and the retrieval card displaced model reasoning (C=0). Retrieval-relevance family (F-1 lineage) now observed crossing into reasoning prompts. The honest relevance caveat was present, which is why U=1 not 0.
